(2) conflict.py: recheck/first_stale give hold/stale_plan at apply (M8), for B3-30 to call inside the gateway txn. baseline.py: revert_culprit_only (oracle-assisted, per object, no conflict check, reports clobbered). Planner rule unchanged. test_conflict.py: F2+x gives exactly 1 write_write_conflict on S-22 by triage, IBAN restored, S-22 differs from S* (R>0). Hero has 0 flags, triage kept. Baseline spares triage on F2+ and clobbers it on F2+x. A gateway write between dry-run and apply halts the S-22 restore, and the new plan has a later as_of_seq plus the flag. Question for maya: on F2+x the conservative view reads make most downstream actions ride, and ADR §6.1 cancels their held items (10 cancels). Should rider items stay held instead? review: [maya · done] All three acceptance lines met; checked against CALL-02 B5 and ADR-05 §6.2/§8. Driver fix is right: the suspend now goes through SystemQueue/FoldedControl and the real Witness, and F2+/S* verify to the last seq (test_world_verify). F2+x: exactly 1 write_write_conflict (S-22, triage), no S-22 restore, IBAN restored, R>0. Hero: 0 flags, triage kept. M8 recheck gives hold/stale_plan and the replan has a later as_of_seq. Baseline is labelled oracle-assisted, spares triage on F2+, clobbers it on F2+x. Local 915 passed/8 skipped; container 926 passed. RULING on the question: riders stay held. ADR-05 §6.1 amended 20 Nov: cancel_outbox only for items of the suspect's own seed actions and for released items of non-re-run actions. Items of riders, replans and flagged actions get no step, stay held, and are listed. Reasons: X4, B2/B3-23 never-silently-dropped, cancel is irreversible. Follow-up is B3-48 (vikram). B3-30 (apply): call conflict.recheck inside the txn and halt at the first stale step. Execute only the cancels the planner emitted. The bench approver releases only items re-held by a re-run step of the approved plan, never rider items, which stay held to T and count in R. Console pin (B3-34): not removable yet. The fixture verifies, but the console test's injected ks.alert still appends at slot 0 outside the gateway and after the last witness push. Ishaan must queue it through SystemQueue (W._tick/extra_tick) first, then drop the pin.
